question: Can the frozen Production Home / Resume architecture carry MAT F1 + TYP F1 + STA F2 as one restrained, color-independent Kymaean app language without reopening information architecture, selecting CLR-01, changing Stage semantics, or introducing motion/runtime authority?

design_result.material: MAT F1 becomes one continuous Home field with restrained edge-open top/right subtractive channels; it does not create a new card stack, icon, direction or Product state.
design_result.typography: TYP F1 Ratio Ladder strengthens role hierarchy while system-ui remains the carrier and content remains primary.
design_result.state: STA F2 marks durable Home selection with an edge witness while keyboard focus remains a separate outer ring on Resume.
design_result.light_dark_parity: PASS - hierarchy, commands, semantic distinctions and material topology are unchanged between neutral Light and Dark presentations.
design_result.clr01: NOT_SELECTED - all integration color remains neutral grayscale so preserved CLR F2/F1 evidence can be judged later in a representative app context.
design_result.stage: UNCHANGED - Stage/Scene preview remains dark and no Stage successor or motion authority is created.

mechanical_preflight.environment: Microsoft Edge Chromium via one deterministic CDP matrix session

recursive_audit.first_matrix_defect: At 320px with 200% text, 12 internal overflow witnesses appeared even though the document itself did not horizontally scroll.
recursive_audit.repair: Allowed narrow navigation controls to grow with enlarged text, allowed Other Productions heading content to wrap, and added minimum-width protection to the continuous material field without changing hierarchy or the three survivor mechanisms.

non_authority: No final material system, production component skin or retirement of Mineral Theater.
No final typeface, typography token or wordmark change.
No final palette, theme or semantic status-color system; CLR-01 remains deferred pending explicit reentry.
No exact native-control geometry, WinUI/XAML implementation or package/runtime authority.
No transcript-dependent motion, cadence, micro-interaction timing or Product-gated Stage control semantics.
No Phase-3 convergence/final-style declaration from one representative section.
next: Use this representative Home/Resume app assembly to reopen the preserved CLR-01 F2 versus F1 contextual decision without retuning either frozen family, then test any selected color logic against accessibility, Light/Dark parity and the proven visual-language mechanisms before broader propagation.
approval: APPROVED BY STANDING DIRECTOR DELEGATION - CLEAN RECURSIVE AUDIT
